content:
A suspicious package delivered to Rep. Henry Cuellar's campaign office in Laredo on Tuesday, November 3, drew a response from Laredo police and hazmat crews, and the FBI is assisting in the investigation, according to KGNS.

The package was discovered around 11:30 a.m. at the office, located in a plaza shopping center on East Calton Road, and was opened by a staff member, KGNS reported. Precautionary screening was done and the scene was cleared at about 1:30 p.m., according to the report. The contents of the package were not released, and the investigation was ongoing.

The campaign said in a statement that the team was grateful for first responders, that it would not share further details at this time, and that all team members are accounted for, according to KGNS.

The FBI San Antonio Division said in a statement that the FBI in Laredo and San Antonio was aware of the incident and was assisting the Laredo Police Department, referred questions to the Laredo Police Department, and had no further information at this time, KGNS reported. The Laredo Police Department had not released information about the package's contents.
